title: Goa Amends Public Gambling Act 1976: Fixes Minimum Casino Entry Age at 21
summary: Restricts casino gambling access across 6 offshore vessels and onshore venues to age 21+.

blocks.content: Restricts casino gambling access across 6 offshore vessels and onshore venues to age 21+.

items: Age Restriction: Mandates minimum entry age of 21 years for designated casino licensed zones.
Late Fee Penalty: Imposes 18% annual penal interest on operators for delayed annual recurring license fees.
